{{Quote|Shut up, Sergeant. I'm in command here!|The command battle droid, to a battle droid sergeant|audio=ShutupSergeant-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCW" />}}
An '''OOM command battle droid''' of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was stationed on the [[planet]] [[Teth]], at the [[B'omarr Order Monastery]]. As forces of the [[Galactic Republic]] searched for the [[Hutt]]let [[Rotta]], who the Separatists held in the monastery, the [[OOM command battle droid]] ordered a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid sergeant (Teth)|B1 battle droid sergeant]] to [[Battle of Teth|attack]] the approaching [[transport]]s, silencing the [[sergeant]] after they brought up the possibility that the transports were their own. After the Republic force landed and reached the base of the cliff below the monastery, the sergeant, attempting to locate the enemy, fell off of the edge, and the command [[battle droid]] ordered them to return to their post. Despite the Separatists' fire against the Republic forces, [[Jedi Master]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], his [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and their force of [[clone trooper]]s reached the monastery, destroying the battle [[droid]]s stationed outside.<ref name="TCW" />
